title: Microsoft Copilot Chat in Outlook: reasoning over inbox, calendar and enterprise data (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout facts, licensing statements and governance controls are supported. The Purview navigation reaches the policy location but should continue to the label condition and processing restriction; this is a minor omission.

claims.claim: Blocking the Copilot app is tenant-wide across the Copilot app, Outlook and the web, including licensed Copilot users.
claims.quote: If you block the Copilot app using the Integrated app control, you block the Copilot app tenant-wide across the Microsoft Copilot app, Outlook, and the web, including for users assigned a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

claims.claim: The Copilot integrated app provides Copilot Chat on the web and in the Copilot app and Outlook across web, desktop and mobile.
claims.quote: The Copilot app is an integrated app that provides Copilot Chat via web, in the Microsoft Copilot app (web, desktop, mobile) and in Outlook (web, desktop, mobile).

claims.claim: Manage Copilot Chat includes Teams in its description of Integrated Apps blocking.
claims.quote: This setting blocks Copilot in the Microsoft Copilot app, Teams, Outlook, and Copilot Chat on the web for all users.

claims.claim: The Integrated Apps reference instead says Teams continues to use its Teams admin center settings.
claims.quote: The app is only be blocked in the Microsoft Copilot application and Outlook. Teams continues to honor the current setting for Teams Apps made in the Teams admin center

claims.claim: Manage Copilot Chat describes Integrated Apps blocking as capable of user/group scoping, while the reference says Block app blocks all users.
claims.quote: Blocking Copilot through Integrated Apps is a tenant-wide control that you can scope to specific users or groups, including licensed users.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls

claims.quote: To prevent access to the Copilot app for unlicensed users, including US government customers, don't deploy the Copilot app to these users.
